events.title: Battle of the Eclipse
events.description: According to traditional dating, a solar eclipse occurred during a battle between the Lydians and the Medes, prompting both sides to stop fighting and agree to peace. The event is often linked to the Greek philosopher Thales, who is said to have predicted it.
events.significance: Often cited as one of the earliest historical events that can be dated precisely through astronomy, though the exact date is debated by scholars.

events.title: Battle of Jumonville Glen
events.description: A Virginia militia force under Lieutenant Colonel George Washington, along with Mingo allies, ambushed a French Canadian detachment in western Pennsylvania, killing the commander Joseph Coulon de Jumonville.
events.significance: This skirmish helped ignite the French and Indian War, which became part of the global Seven Years' War and reshaped colonial power in North America.

events.title: Founding of the First Republic of Azerbaijan
events.description: The Azerbaijan Democratic Republic declared independence from the Russian Transcaucasian Federation, becoming the first secular democratic republic in the Muslim world.
events.significance: It granted women voting rights in 1918, earlier than many Western nations, and remains a key symbol of Azerbaijani national identity; it was ended by Soviet takeover in 1920.

events.title: Golden Gate Bridge Opens to Pedestrians
events.description: The Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco opened to pedestrian traffic, with vehicle traffic beginning the following day after an official ceremony.
events.significance: The bridge was the longest suspension bridge main span in the world at the time and became an iconic symbol of San Francisco and American engineering.

events.title: Pakistan Conducts Nuclear Tests
events.description: Pakistan carried out nuclear tests in the Chagai Hills of Balochistan in response to India's tests earlier that month, becoming the seventh country to openly demonstrate nuclear weapons capability.
events.significance: The tests escalated nuclear tensions in South Asia and prompted international sanctions and renewed concern over nuclear proliferation.
